erro.nao_existe.texto: The page or item does not exist (it may have been removed). Go back to the start.
erro.invalido.texto: A value you sent is not valid. Go back and check the fields.
erro.outro.texto: That could not be done. Reload the page and try again.
erro.indisponivel.texto: joBot is not ready for this right now. Close it and open it again with jobot abrir.
erro.interno.texto: Something went wrong on joBot's side. The error was written to {log}. Try again and, if it happens again, open an issue with that file.
